description: [needs a free API key — this call will fail without one: https://visa.orizn.app/visa-api/register?source=mcp-remote, then reconnect with ?key=<key>] Transit and layover rules for a country being connected through: airside/landside rules and how many free transit hours its main hubs grant. Call it for layovers, stopovers and connecting flights — not for entering a country as a destination, which is check_visa_requirement. IMPORTANT: this data is modelled PER TRANSIT COUNTRY, not per passport nationality. The answer is the same for every passport, the `passport` argument is recorded but does not narrow the result, and only 44 transit countries are covered. Present the reply as general hub rules to confirm with the airline or the transit country's authority, never as a per-nationality ruling. When the country is not covered the tool answers {status: "unavailable"} instead of guessing. Needs the Starter plan ($49/month, 30,000 requests) or above and costs 1 request. On a free key this call is refused before anything is charged, with the upgrade link.

lang.description: Language code. One of: fr, en, es, pt, de, ja, ko, zh, ru, it, ar, hi, th, vi, tl. Defaults to en.

passport.description: Traveller's passport, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (e.g. IND). Recorded, but does not narrow the answer.

transit_country.description: Country being transited, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (e.g. ARE for a Dubai layover, TUR for Istanbul).

name: check_transit_visa
title: Transit and layover rules
